full_judgment: 1 approached the father of the plaintiff No. 11 for permission to reside in some portion of the suit land temporarily and they were accordingly granted permission. The plaintiffs asked the defendant Nos. 1- 4 to vacate the said portion of the suit land but they finally refused in Ashwin, 1379. The suit land has been wrongly recorded in the name of defendant No. 6 in S.A. Khatian. As a result cloud has been cast upon the plaintiffs' title to the suit land.
